title: Zero-trust identity and least privilege
guidance: Use dedicated service accounts per workload, Workload Identity Federation instead of keys, and IAM Conditions; avoid primitive Owner/Editor roles.

title: Defend the perimeter in depth
guidance: Front internet-facing services with Cloud Load Balancing + Cloud Armor, use IAP for admin surfaces, and VPC Service Controls around sensitive data.

title: Encrypt and manage keys and secrets
guidance: Store secrets in Secret Manager, use CMEK via Cloud KMS for regulated data, never embed credentials in code or images.

title: Detect and respond
guidance: Enable Security Command Center, Cloud Audit Logs (incl. Data Access) and alerting on anomalous IAM grants.

title: Define SLOs from user journeys
guidance: Set SLOs on critical user journeys, derive error budgets, and alert on burn rate rather than raw thresholds.

title: Eliminate single points of failure
guidance: Prefer regional managed services, multi-zone node pools, HA databases; go multi-region where the composite SLO requires it.

title: Design for graceful degradation
guidance: Use timeouts, retries with jitter, circuit breakers and async queues (Pub/Sub) to decouple dependencies.

title: Test recovery
guidance: Document RTO/RPO, automate backups and run regular DR and chaos exercises.

title: Right-size and autoscale
guidance: Prefer serverless/autoscaling (Cloud Run, GKE Autopilot); scale to zero for spiky workloads; right-size with Active Assist recommendations.

title: Commit for steady state
guidance: Use committed use discounts (CUDs) for predictable baseline usage and Spot VMs for fault-tolerant batch.

title: Make cost visible
guidance: Label every resource, export billing to BigQuery, set budgets and alerts per team/environment.

title: Everything as code
guidance: Provision with Terraform, deploy via CI/CD with automated tests and progressive rollouts.

title: Observe the system
guidance: Structured logging, distributed tracing (OpenTelemetry/Cloud Trace) and dashboards on golden signals.

title: Cache and place data near users
guidance: Use Cloud CDN, Memorystore and regional placement to meet latency objectives.

title: Govern data by classification
guidance: Classify data, enforce residency, use Dataplex/Data Catalog policy tags and column-level security.

title: Responsible generative AI
guidance: Ground models on approved data, screen prompts/responses (Model Armor), evaluate continuously and keep humans in the loop for high-impact decisions.

title: Design analytics for scale
guidance: Partition and cluster BigQuery tables, separate storage and compute, and use streaming via Pub/Sub + Dataflow for real time.
